summary: On the main deck, everyone has gathered behind Tank to watch the fight, 'like watching a game of Mortal Kombat.' MOUSE reacts with amazement to what he sees, exclaiming 'Jeezus Keeerist! He's fast!' and pointing out that Neo's 'neural-kinetics' are 'way above normal.'

what_changes.after: noticing that Neo's neural-kinetics are 'way above normal'
what_changes.evidence: Look at his neural-kinetics! They're way above normal!

event_hint.one_line: The crew watches Neo and Morpheus's dojo battle on the deck screens, and MOUSE notes Neo's abnormal speed.
